rule: S_N must not be null (mandatory primary key)
rationale: S_N is the primary identifier and join key with 100% coverage required for referential integrity

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: Serial number identifier must uniquely identify each customer record; evidence shows 30 distinct values across 30 records

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (referential integrity)
rationale: S_N serves as a one-to-one shared join key with Acc_Info_dirty; 96.7% coverage on related table indicates potential unmatched records that must be flagged

rule: Account_No must not be null (mandatory account identifier)
rationale: Account number is a mandatory business identifier linking to account information

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Evidence indicates values are always 4 characters long (1001-1028) and intended data type is string; flags values with incorrect length

rule: Account_No should be unique (flag duplicates)
rationale: Evidence shows 28 distinct values across 30 records with duplicates ('1001', '1010'); duplicates may indicate data entry errors or multiple records per account requiring verification

rule: Name must not be null (mandatory customer name)
rationale: Customer name is mandatory for identity verification

rule: Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles: bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Evidence shows 6.7% deviation from Title Case ('WANG SHI JIE', 'lim wei jie'); standardizes to dominant format while preserving culturally specific lowercase particles

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID_No must not be null (mandatory identification number)
rationale: National ID is mandatory for customer identification

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow format aXXXXXXXa; 6.6% deviate ('1916569C' missing prefix, 'F212233V' with 6 digits); validates standard Singapore ID format

rule: ID_No must be unique (no duplicates)
rationale: National ID should uniquely identify individuals; evidence shows 29 distinct values with one duplicate ('F1011121T')

rule: Race must not be null (mandatory demographic field)
rationale: Race is a required demographic attribute with no missing values in current data

rule: Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows only three semantic categories with casing inconsistencies (MALAY, malay, indian); standardizes to canonical Title Case values

rule: Gender must not be null (mandatory demographic field)
rationale: Gender is a required demographic attribute with no missing values in current data

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female (Title Case)
rationale: Evidence shows four distinct values due to casing inconsistencies (male, FEMALE); restricts to canonical Title Case binary values

rule: Age must not be null (mandatory demographic field)
rationale: Age is required for service eligibility and demographic analysis

rule: Age must be numeric (parseable as number)
rationale: Evidence shows one non-numeric value 'Twenty-five' (3.3%) in int64 column; flags text representations that cannot be converted to numeric

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 (inclusive)
rationale: Domain constraint for human age; evidence shows anomalous negative value (-5) and value below 13 (4) flagged as potentially unrealistic

rule: Age must not be negative
rationale: Age represents a non-negative quantity; evidence includes value -5 which violates business logic

rule: Age should be at least 13 for service account eligibility
rationale: Evidence flags values below 13 (4, -5) as potentially unrealistic for a service account; business rule requiring minimum age of 13

rule: Contact_No must not be null (mandatory contact information)
rationale: Evidence shows 6.7% missing values (2 NULL records); contact number is required for customer communication

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (+65 prefix, 8 digits)
rationale: Dataset represents Singapore customers; evidence shows format inconsistencies and one 7-digit truncated value ('8964359'); validates against Singapore numbering plan

rule: Email must not be null (mandatory contact information)
rationale: Email is required for account communication and verification

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence shows 13.3% structurally malformed values: missing @ ('not-an-email', 'useremail.com'), embedded space ('zx91 @example.com'), duplicate @ ('nabilah@@example.com')

rule: Email must be unique (no duplicates)
rationale: Email should uniquely identify customer accounts; evidence shows 29 distinct values with one duplicate ('thm@example.com')

rule: Country must not be null (mandatory geographic field)
rationale: Country is required for geographic validation and service eligibility

rule: Country must be standardized to 'Singapore' (flag non-standard representations)
rationale: Evidence shows 8 inconsistent representations of Singapore (SINGAPORE, singapore, S'pore, SG, Singapura, 新加坡, Republic of Singapore); enforces canonical 'Singapore' value

rule: Street_Name must not be null (mandatory address component)
rationale: Street name is required for postal address completeness

rule: Street_Name must be in Title Case (not ALL CAPS)
rationale: Evidence shows one all-caps entry 'HOLLAND ROAD' (3.3%) deviating from dominant Title Case convention; standardizes address formatting

rule: Postal_Code must not be null (mandatory address component)
rationale: Postal code is required for address validation and geographic analysis

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits; evidence shows varying lengths (4, 5, 6 digits) with values like '6907' (4 digits) and '99999' (5 digits) potentially missing leading zeros or truncated

rule: Name particles must match Gender: Bin/s/o indicates Male, Binte/d/o indicates Female
rationale: Cultural/linguistic consistency: Malay 'Bin' and Indian 's/o' (son of) indicate male; Malay 'Binte' and Indian 'd/o' (daughter of) indicate female; flags demographic inconsistencies

check_params.logic: ((re.search(r'\bBin\b', str(row['Name'])) is not None or re.search(r'\bs/o\b', str(row['Name'])) is not None) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or ((re.search(r'\bBinte\b', str(row['Name'])) is not None or re.search(r'\bd/o\b', str(row['Name'])) is not None) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty (accounting for case differences)
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires consistency between customer bio name and account info full name; sample shows variations like 'lim wei jie' vs 'Wang Shi Jie' (case) and potential truncation

check_params.semantic_check: Name should match Full_Name (case-insensitive comparison allowing for minor variations)

rule: ID_No must match ID in Acc_Info_dirty
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires national ID consistency across tables for identity verification

rule: Account_No must match Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires account number consistency across customer bio and account info tables

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No must exactly match Account_No in sibling table
